stories.title: Canada retaliates with $20 billion tariff strike as U.S. trade war escalates
new_facts: Canada has actually enacted dollar-for-dollar retaliatory tariffs on $20B in US goods, not just planned.
Canada announced C$27.6B ($19.94B) in tariffs on steel/dairy plus a C$7.5B aid package for affected businesses/workers.
Names Canadian Finance Minister François-Philippe Champagne as the official announcing the dollar-for-dollar tariffs effective Sept 8.
Trump denied pushing against one of Canada's official languages during a five-post Tuesday tweetstorm.
NYT reports US offered what it called the best deal of any country, but Canada saw required concessions as unthinkable.
Trump threatens to rename Lake Ontario amid trade war escalation.
Carney says Canada has leverage: 'We have what the world wants.'
stories.line: Trump imposed tariffs on Canadian goods; Canada announced $20 billion in retaliatory tariffs on U.S. steel, fish, and other products.

CIA, Department of Defense and Air Force all declined to comment on the trip
CIA Director Ratcliffe secretly in Moscow for meetings; US Air Force C-17A plane and motorcade spotted

Adds that Doug Ford threatened to cut off electricity and minerals to the US.
Trump accuses Carney of fabricating claims about French-language demands in trade talks.
Doug Ford calls Trump a 'dictator' and 'the king of bankruptcies'.

stories.title: U.S. escalates Iran sanctions, threatens secondary penalties on trading partners
new_facts: New actor: Biden-era economist Phil Luck argues China unlikely to halt Iranian oil purchases despite threats.
Names Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent; reveals operation name 'Operation Economic Outcast' and D-Day comparison quote.
China says it will 'safeguard its own interests' and calls for ceasefire, saying sanctions won't resolve conflict.
New number: 60 entities targeted in latest sanctions wave over oil, weapons, cyber ties.
Treasury's own press release formally announces 'Operation Economic Outcast' as an 'unprecedented, whole-of-government' campaign.
Iran's economy minister confirms 2-year prep plan; quotes Bessent calling it the 'greatest financial offensive' ever.
US imposes new Iran sanctions, calls them an "economic D-Day"; Tehran leaders expect to survive them.
New story: US touted 'toughest sanctions ever' on Iran but experts say it fell short, fearing economic fallout.
Iran vows retaliation, warns US to 'expect an attack' after sanctions widened.
US sanctions target Chinese firms over Iran links while sparing major Chinese banks.
China warns Trump against 'economic warfare' via sanctions and threatens retaliation.
Names US Treasury secretary as source of threatened wide-ranging measures; China and Iran dismiss threats.
stories.line: Trump administration escalates economic sanctions on Iran and threatens countries trading with it, including China.

Trump's super PAC has spent money boosting Graham; some Republicans reportedly expect her to lose.
